package: Jarvis OBD Reliability + Windows Native Transport
releaseGate: Release only after v0.4 contextual voice passes and v0.5 is hardware-smoke-tested with a supported Windows USB adapter.
delivery: GitHub stable release -> in-app Frissítés egy kattintással
